**Finding: COMPLIANT (at/above preferred) — no redline proposed.**

- **§ 13.1 (p0197)** — IBM takes ownership and MSL presently assigns all IP in hardware, software, design and documentation of all Products; **p0198** extends this to MSL inventions on Products and on IBM processes, MSL retaining only a use right "in the performance of its obligations hereunder" (service delivery, not independent exploitation).
- **§ 13.3 a) (p0208)** — MSL gets no rights in IBM pre-existing IP, only a royalty-free licence to use disclosed confidential information "necessary to manufacture Products solely for IBM" — the data/confidential-information licence is confined to providing the Services.
- **§ 20.0 (p1088)** — MSL owns commonly used production tooling, consistent with the fallback allowance for Vendor generic tools.
- No joint ownership and no assignment of IBM IP or data to MSL anywhere in the document.
- Noted only in the rationale (not flagged): no express MSL pre-existing-IP retention statement (favourable to us) and no embedded-Vendor-IP licence back, with § 24.1's "no software title or license" wording limited to transition-period system access rather than Product deliverables.
